name: Anubhav Dwivedi
research_summary: Dwivedi's research interests include computer modeling of fast, compressible flows, plasma dynamics, uncertainty, and data-driven methods. His documented work also examines how hypersonic boundary layers become unstable and transition toward turbulence.
